original_test_intent: Verify a fully populated system survives 100 cold reboot cycles at 0C/+5% rails without device loss or platform errors.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Populate all CPU/DIMM/HDD/GPU/network slots and run 100 cold reboot cycles.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: No disallowed log event, hang/blue screen, or device loss.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED MANUAL ONLY with cycle waveform, boot-ready and no-hidden-retry requirements.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Operator controls chamber, rails and cold-power mechanism; PA Manager or the approved project cycle script should control the defined 100-cycle plan.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Fully populated system, 0C/+5% rails, 100 cold reboots.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Power waveform/dwell, boot-ready timeout, baseline inventory, cycle checks, safety stops and approved count override.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: An approved lower cycle count completes only the project run and leaves the Master difference.

original_method: Original cold reboot requirement and count are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use PA Manager Cycle or the approved project cycle script when it can express cold-power waveform, per-cycle readiness and inventory evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Project power-control and full hardware topology.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved PA Manager/project cycle SOP and platform power specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic evidence and safety stops; it does not implement a competing cycle controller.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Must retain the approved cold-cycle count and device inventory checks.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Waveform, readiness, baseline and stop rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Uncontrolled power cycling can damage data or strand the DUT.

missing_inputs: Boot-ready timeout and full inventory baseline
safety_boundaries: No hidden retry or count reset
No uncontrolled mains action or log clearing
expected_evidence: Cycles 1-100 with power and boot-ready timestamps
no_automatic_retry: The next approved loop is not a retry; an extra replacement cycle requires approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: Cycle/margin engineer evaluates completion and anomalies.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already aligned with existing cycle control, preserved 100 iterations and prohibited hidden retries.
